propositions: Escape-class detection gaps are closed by five prose upgrades to implement-side skill and test-design docs targeting parity siblings, config read-but-miswired, op-level contention semantics, gate findings without oracle upgrades, and residual gaps at close.

Parity census (4a) enumerates five parallel surfaces (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) with disposition (in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-reason) for each change-touched surface.
Config-effect contrast tests (test-design §6) prove each config key changes behavior through the real read path (default vs non-default) rather than merely parsing a value.

Contention triggers (4b) route by op-level shape—composed/check-then-act writes, write-storm/retry-reclamation, and read-integrity-under-contention—to existing shared suites (two_clones, storm, reads-under-sync-contention harness).
Behavioral gate findings (4g) receive RED tests before fixes; non-behavioral findings are fixed directly without test requirement.
Phase-5 residual-gap disposition sweep enumerates all out-of-scope census slots, exclusions, and deferred advisories with forced-artifact wording (filed, accepted, fixed).
